Reflection:
The Files window is open showing the Documents folder, but to upload it via SwissTransfer I need to switch back to Firefox, open a new tab, and navigate to https://swisstransfer.com.

```python
import pyautogui, time

# Switch to Firefox by clicking its icon in the dock
pyautogui.click(20, 780)
time.sleep(1)

# Open a new tab
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 't')
time.sleep(0.5)

# Navigate to SwissTransfer
pyautogui.typewrite('https://swisstransfer.com', interval=0.05)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(2)
```
